Amount parameter is only consumed by the balance arithmetic inside transfer; merge into the arithmetic operation.
Spender parameter exists only to index the allowance mapping written by approve.
Amount parameter is only stored as the allowance value inside approve.
Source address parameter only feeds the allowance/balance subtraction performed by transferFrom.
Destination parameter only indexes the balance credit inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter is only consumed by the subtraction arithmetic in transferFrom.
Spender parameter becomes the arbitrary external callback target, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
Allowance amount is forwarded straight into the external callback.
Raw bytes parameter is only forwarded to receiveApproval.
Target address parameter is the external contract call destination.

Candidate owner parameter is only assigned to newOwner inside transferOwnership.
